name: Samson
summary: A Nazarite from birth, given great strength by the Spirit of the LORD, who judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines. Betrayed by Delilah and blinded, he pulled down the house of Dagon on the Philistines at his death.

key_moments.title: Tearing Apart a Lion
key_moments.description: On the way to Timnath a young lion roared at Samson, and the Spirit of the LORD came on him, so he tore it apart with his bare hands. Later he found bees and honey in its body.

key_moments.title: Kills a Thousand Men with a Jawbone
key_moments.description: The men of Judah bound Samson and handed him to the Philistines at Lehi. The Spirit of the LORD came on him, the ropes fell off, and he killed a thousand men with the jawbone of a donkey.

key_moments.title: Carrying Off the Gates of Gaza
key_moments.description: When the men of Gaza waited to kill him, Samson rose at midnight, pulled up the city gates, posts and all, and carried them to the top of a hill before Hebron.

key_moments.title: Delilah Learns His Secret
key_moments.description: After Delilah pressed him day after day, Samson told her no razor had ever touched his head. She had his hair shaved while he slept, the LORD left him, and the Philistines took him.

key_moments.title: Bringing Down the House
key_moments.description: Blinded and made to grind in prison at Gaza, Samson was brought out to entertain the Philistines at a feast for their god Dagon. He prayed for strength one last time and leaned on the two middle pillars, and the house fell, killing more at his death than in his life.
